title: BGB-21447 (Bcl-2 Inhibitor) Combinations for Adults With Hormone-Receptor Positive (HR+)/​Human Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor 2 Negative (HER2-) Metastatic Breast Cancer

rules.rule_text: Histologically or cytologically confirmed HR+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer
rules.source_text: Histologically or cytologically confirmed HR+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer.

rules.rule_text: ≥ 1 prior line(s) of treatment for advanced/metastatic disease, including prior endocrine therapy and CDK4/6 inhibitor
rules.source_text: Part 1A and 1B: Participants must have received ≥ 1 prior line(s) of treatment for advanced/metastatic disease, including prior endocrine therapy and CDK4/6 inhibitor in either the adjuvant or advanced/metastatic setting.
rules.notes: Must include both prior endocrine therapy AND CDK4/6 inhibitor

rules.rule_text: 1-3 prior line(s) of treatment for advanced/metastatic disease, including prior endocrine therapy and CDK4/6 inhibitor
rules.source_text: Part 2: Participants must have received 1-3 prior line(s) of treatment for advanced/metastatic disease, including prior endocrine therapy and CDK4/6 inhibitor in either the adjuvant or advanced/metastatic setting.
rules.notes: Must include both prior endocrine therapy AND CDK4/6 inhibitor

rules.rule_text: Female participants must have ovarian function suppression using GnRH agonists or be postmenopausal
rules.source_text: Female participants will be required (either continue ongoing or initiate as soon as feasible) to have ovarian function suppression using gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) agonists (such as goserelin) or be postmenopausal.
Participants must have a stable Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status of ≤ 1.

rules.rule_text: Female participants of childbearing potential and nonsterile male participants must agree to use highly effective birth control during study and for specified periods after each drug
rules.source_text: Female participants of childbearing potential and nonsterile male participants with female partners of childbearing potential must be willing to use a highly effective method of birth control for the duration of the study and for 7 days after the last dose of BGB-21447, 6 months after the last dose of BGB-43395, and 2 years after the last dose of fulvestrant.
rules.notes: Contraception agreement with specific timelines per drug

rules.rule_text: Food effect substudy participants must be able and willing to fast overnight (≥ 10 hours) and consume a high-fat meal
rules.source_text: Food effect substudy only: Participants who are able and willing to fast overnight (≥ 10 hours) and consume a high-fat meal.
For triplet combination cohorts only: Prior therapy selectively targeting CDK4.
Known leptomeningeal disease or uncontrolled, untreated brain metastases.
Known leptomeningeal disease or uncontrolled, untreated brain metastases.

rules.rule_text: Any malignancy ≤ 3 years before first dose of study treatment, except the cancer under investigation and locally recurring cancer treated with curative intent
rules.source_text: Any malignancy ≤ 3 years before the first dose of study treatment(s) except for the specific cancer under investigation in this study and any locally recurring cancer that has been treated with curative intent (eg, treated papillary thyroid carcinoma, resected basal or squamous cell skin cancer, superficial bladder cancer, or carcinoma in situ of the cervix or breast).
rules.notes: 3-year window; excludes study cancer and locally recurring cancer with curative treatment

rules.rule_text: History of hepatitis B or active Hepatitis C infection
rules.source_text: History of hepatitis B or active Hepatitis C infection

rules.rule_text: Untreated chronic hepatitis B or chronic hepatitis B virus carriers with HBV DNA > 500 IU/ml (or > 2500 copies/ml) at screening
rules.source_text: China Only: Untreated chronic hepatitis B or chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) carriers with HBV DNA > 500 IU/ml (or > 2500 copies/ml) at screening.
rules.notes: HBV DNA threshold > 500 IU/ml or > 2500 copies/ml
